name: Hausberger
beschreibung: The Hausberger is situated in the sunny, peaceful district of Gänsleit in Söll in the Wilder Kaiser holiday region in Tyrol. Styled with authentic alpine timber furnishings, the comfortable guest rooms feature en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing sweeping vistas of the Hohe Salve and the rugged Wilder Kaiser cliffs. After active hours outdoors, guests can unwind and recharge in the property's sauna area. A wholesome breakfast buffet filled with regional delicacies is served each morning. Söll's charming village centre with its eateries and shops is an easy walk away. In winter, the complimentary ski bus brings skiers to the base gondola terminal of the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental in minutes. Summer delivers themed adventures like Hexenwasser.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy Tyrolean guesthouse in Gänsleit in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser with comfortable rooms, sauna, and close to the SkiWelt.
